mapper.sql: WITH user_subjects AS ( SELECT 'USER' AS sub_type, #{userId} AS sub_id UNION ALL SELECT 'DEPT' AS sub_type, dc.ancestor_id AS sub_id FROM user_dept ud JOIN dept_closure dc ON ud.dept_id = dc.descendant_id WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId} AND ud.status IN (1, 2) UNION ALL SELECT 'POST' AS sub_type, up.post_id AS sub_id FROM user_post up WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND up.status IN (1, 2) -- 未来扩展：在此处 UNION ALL 增加 PROJECT 或其他主体即可 -- UNION ALL SELECT 'PROJECT', project_id FROM user_project ... )

WITH base_subjects AS ( SELECT 'USER' AS sub_type, #{userId} AS sub_id UNION ALL SELECT 'DEPT' AS sub_type, dc.ancestor_id AS sub_id FROM user_dept ud JOIN dept_closure dc ON ud.dept_id = dc.descendant_id WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId} AND ud.status IN (1, 2) UNION ALL SELECT 'POST' AS sub_type, up.post_id AS sub_id FROM user_post up WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND up.status IN (1, 2) ), role_subjects AS ( SELECT DISTINCT 'ROLE' AS sub_type, sr.id AS sub_id FROM grant_table gt JOIN base_subjects bs ON gt.subject_type = bs.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = bs.sub_id JOIN sys_role sr ON sr.role_code = gt.role_code WHERE sr.status = 1 AND sr.is_deleted = 0), all_subjects AS (SELECT bs.sub_type, bs.sub_id FROM base_subjects bs UNION ALL SELECT rs.sub_type, rs.sub_id FROM role_subjects rs)
